rows.description: `GraphBuilder.ts --rebuild` parses all 520 notes and constructs valid node/edge graph in under 60 seconds
`GraphBuilder.ts --stats` reports accurate node count, edge count, orphan count, most/least connected notes
Semantic search for "machine learning optimization" returns relevant notes from multiple folders (Data Science, Applied ML, ML at Scale)
Concept clustering identifies at least 5 distinct knowledge domains matching the vault's topic structure
Gap detector correctly identifies broken links, orphan notes, and stub notes
"What do I know about transformers?" returns a structured response with relevant notes, their connections, and a concept summary
"How does NLP connect to my Writing notes?" traces paths through the graph and explains bridge concepts
"Where are my knowledge gaps?" produces a prioritized list with TELOS-aligned suggestions
Tag navigation shows all tags with counts and co-occurrence patterns
Graph insights persist in PAI memory and are available in subsequent sessions
All outputs are text-based, concept-first, and structured (no reliance on visual graph rendering)
Skill integrates cleanly with InformationManager (uses existing `_Context.md` files, respects `config/obsidian.json`)
